description: Entries the lab spotted but did not execute on its RTX 3090 FE rig when the list was written, with the reason. 'route' separates weights spotted for the rig (local-weights) from cloud or API-only models (cloud-api) and from tools that are not models (tool); 'measured_later' marks entries measured afterwards (see their model pages).

entries.name: Apertus v1.5 (multimodal, 262k context)
entries.reason: Waiting for fine-tuning support; never pulled.

entries.name: Big Pickle (OpenCode Zen)
entries.reason: Benchmarked through a cloud route, never executed on this rig.

entries.name: BioMistral-7B
entries.reason: Set aside at scouting: English PubMed and clinical medicine, not the target subject, and an older base.

entries.name: Cloud routes (claude-sonnet-5, claude-opus-5, gpt-5.5, gemini-3.1-pro-preview)
entries.reason: Cloud fallback models; nothing runs locally.

entries.name: Cold-Fusion V1.1 GGUF Q4_K_M without imatrix (dimitry-none)
entries.reason: Dominated by the mradermacher imatrix build.

entries.name: Cold-Fusion V1.1 GGUF Q8_0 (mradermacher, 30 GB)
entries.reason: Would only fit the disk floor by evicting two parked models; never downloaded.

entries.name: Cold-Fusion V1.1 NInfer bundle (pyros-vault) / ninfer-3090 engine
entries.reason: Exploratory engine route: sm86 compatibility of the fork undocumented, single GPU only.

entries.name: DeepSeek-V4 / V4-Flash
entries.reason: Kernels need SM 9.0 or newer; unusable on Ampere.

entries.name: Devstral Small 2 24B (cyankiwi AWQ)
entries.reason: On a shortlist; weights were found on disk but no run was recorded.

entries.name: DFlash 2 drafter for Qwen3.8-27B
entries.reason: Listed as not yet measured when this list was written; it was measured later in the speculative-decoding A/B (see its model page).

entries.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash, Qwen3.8-Max-0902, Claude Fable 5.1
entries.reason: Cloud models (API); nothing runs locally.

entries.name: gemma-4-12B-coder-GGUF (12 GB)
entries.reason: Weights found on disk and purged; no measurement recorded.

entries.name: GLM-4.5-Air / GLM-4.6-Air
entries.reason: 4.6-Air does not exist. 4.5-Air needs about 64.5 GB, more than one pair's 48 GB under vLLM; not tried under llama.cpp with part of the weights in system RAM, which is how larger GGUF models ran here.

entries.name: GLM-5.3 (open weights announced)
entries.reason: Does not fit the two-card 48 GB template; watched for a distilled line.

entries.name: GLM-5.3-Flash UD-Q3 (GGUF)
entries.reason: Needs about 125 GB of RAM against 64 GB per VM.

entries.name: GLM-OCR 0.9B
entries.reason: No OCR need at the time; GLM-OCR was measured later on the document-reading bench.

entries.name: gpt-oss-120b (MXFP4)
entries.reason: Not tried. Too large for one pair's 48 GB under vLLM; under llama.cpp it could run on one pair with part of the weights in system RAM, as larger GGUF models did here.

entries.name: Hy4 Preview 770B
entries.reason: API only; weights not published.

entries.name: Kyutai Pocket TTS
entries.reason: A light CPU TTS option, never pulled; Kokoro was tested instead.

entries.name: LettuceDetect-610M (French faithfulness judge)
entries.reason: Recommended to replace HHEM, never pulled.

entries.name: Mistral OCR (API)
entries.reason: A cloud OCR service used for document preparation, not a local model.

entries.name: Muse Spark 1.3
entries.reason: API only; weights not published.

entries.name: NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard 0.2 (router)
entries.reason: A routing tool, not a model; tried and not adopted.

entries.name: Ox Alpha (OpenCode Zen)
entries.reason: A cloud model whose free window expired before the test.

entries.name: PhoneLLM alpha-1 BF16 under vLLM
entries.reason: Needs about 63 GB of VRAM, over the 48 GB of an NVLink pair; only the GGUF Q4 build was tested.

entries.name: pyannote speaker-diarization community-1
entries.reason: Recommended for diarisation, never pulled.

entries.name: Qwen3-Coder-Next 80B-A3B (bullpoint AWQ-4bit)
entries.reason: Not tried. The AWQ build was judged too large for one pair's 48 GB under vLLM, and the two pairs are separate machines; it was not tried as a GGUF with part of the weights in system RAM, which is how larger GGUF models ran here.

entries.name: Qwen3-Embedding-4B + Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B
entries.reason: On a retrieval shortlist, never pulled; bge-m3 kept.

entries.name: Qwen3.6-27B dense (QuantTrio AWQ)
entries.reason: On a shortlist, never downloaded.

entries.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B MTP k=2
entries.reason: Skipped at first because k=1 was not conclusive; MTP k=2 was measured later in the speculative-decoding A/B.

entries.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-MTP-Q8 (31 GB)
entries.reason: A variant found on disk and purged; no run recorded.

entries.name: Qwen3.7 Max and frontier models (355B to 2.8T)
entries.reason: Closed weights or far out of class.

entries.name: Qwen3.8-27B official FP8
entries.reason: FP8 is emulated through Marlin on Ampere (about 13 % slower), so it was avoided; the NVFP4 checkpoint was tried instead and failed on its FP8 attention layers.

entries.name: Qwen3.8-27B QLoRA (Unsloth recipe)
entries.reason: A 27B fine-tuning round that was never opened.

entries.name: Qwen3.8-27B via Ollama (qwen3.8:27b)
entries.reason: A conditional test block that was never opened.

entries.name: Qwen3.8-27B-Cold-Fusion-GAIN-V1.1 NEO-MAX-MTP (DavidAU GGUF)
entries.reason: Variant excluded because its coding scores trailed the Qwen3.6-27B merge.

entries.name: Qwen3.8-9B-Distill abliterated variants
entries.reason: Out of the campaign's scope; the plain model was measured.

entries.name: Qwen3.8-Max 2.4T-A95B
entries.reason: Cloud API only; far beyond any local VRAM even at 1 bit.

entries.name: SD 3.5 Large
entries.reason: Excluded: community licence with a revenue threshold, and VRAM too tight.

entries.name: Superlinked SIE (inference engine)
entries.reason: An engine, not a model; its four models are listed as tested models.

entries.name: Thomson-1.0-Small GGUF Q4_K_M (bartowski)
entries.reason: Downloaded as a fallback, never served: the AWQ build passed its checks first.

entries.name: Voxtral-4B-TTS, Fish Audio S2 Pro, FLUX.2 9B and larger
entries.reason: Excluded for their licences (non-commercial or research only).

entries.name: WhisperX large-v3 / whisper-large-v3-distil-fr
entries.reason: Recommended for batch transcription, never pulled; faster-whisper kept.

entries.name: zerodigest YMQ (mixed tiers)
entries.reason: Quantisation method not published; watched only.
